the falling film heat-transfer coefficient of the horizontal-tube evaporator is a complex function of the liquid load, the evaporation boiling point, the temperature difference and the tube diameter.The film thickness and the heat-transfer coefficient are increased with the liquid load and the tube diameter,but decreased with the evaporation boiling-point and the temperature difference.The waving intensity of the film increases with the liquid load,decreases with the temperature difference,and is independent of the tube diameter and the evaporation boiling temperature.
